name: Ravencrest Monument
summary: On southern Azshara’s windswept cliffs, Ravencrest Monument lies broken above the Great Sea. Hostile Spitelash naga stalk the remains of the ancient night elven colossus.

sections.title: Ruins of a Colossus
sections.body:
Southeast of the Ruins of Eldarath, Ravencrest Monument rises above the ocean. The ancient colossus once showed the skill of Kaldorei stoneworkers. Now only its enormous legs remain, fixed to a stone base. Its torso and head lie in fragments, buried in the cliff dirt or lost beneath the waves.

To reach this remote coast, you must cross Azshara’s mainland bridges. Steep, rocky drops block any approach from the sea.

sections.title: A Forgotten Legacy
sections.body:
Some scholars believe Ravencrest Monument honors Lord Kur'talos Ravencrest, the famed noble who rallied and led the night elven host after Zin-Azshari fell in the War of the Ancients. Its closeness to ancient Eldarath and the surviving stonework leave its origins uncertain.

Spitelash naga now claim the cliff. They defend the fallen monument with fierce aggression, where pilgrims or night elven caretakers once might have stood.

faq.answer: Ravencrest Monument is a ruined night elven colossus on a coastal promontory in southern Azshara. Only its enormous stone legs remain upright; the rest lies shattered across the clifftop.

faq.q: Who was the monument built to honor?
faq.answer: The monument’s name points to House Ravencrest, best known for Lord Kur'talos Ravencrest, who led mortal resistance against the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients. Since the monument stands near Eldarath, it may honor Kur'talos or an earlier ancestor from before the Great Sundering.

faq.q: How do you reach the monument?
aliases: how to get to ravencrest monument
faq.answer: You must cross southern Azshara by land, using stone bridges near the Ruins of Eldarath to reach the promontory. Sheer cliffs block any approach from the sea.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the monument today?
faq.answer: Spitelash naga inhabit the clifftop and surrounding terraces, making the ancient ruins perilous to explore alone.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see Ravencrest Monument as a reminder of the ancient Kaldorei Empire and the Ravencrest noble line. The family’s resistance during the War of the Ancients saved Azeroth from demonic annihilation.
As a warrior, you hear the weight of the Ravencrest name in the tale of Kur'talos Ravencrest, foremost general of the mortal forces during the Burning Legion’s catastrophic invasion.
